title: Terminal delegation follow-up bypasses the per-parent active delegation cap
outcome: Re-arming a terminal delegation for a follow-up checks the per-parent active capacity atomically, under the same lock as the state change, so a parent can never hold more active children than its limit. A test covers a follow-up racing concurrent spawns at the cap and shows the follow-up is refused with the truthful capacity message.
acceptance: Terminal delegation follow-up bypasses the per-parent active delegation cap is done
